description: O Grupo Seres, em parceria com empresa Industria de Plásticos, seleciona profissional para atuar na função de Gerente de Manutenção Atividades: O Gerente de Manutenção na Indústria PET é o profissional responsável por planejar, gerenciar as atividades de manutenção corretiva, preventiva e preditiva dos equipamentos e instalações da fábrica. Seu papel é garantir que todas as máquinas e sistemas estejam operando de forma eficiente e segura, contribuindo para a continuidade e a qualidade do processo produtivo. Principais Responsabilidades 1. Gestão da Equipe de Manutenção Coordenar e supervisionar a equipe de manutenção, definindo funções, delegando atividades e garantindo que todos os membros da equipe desempenhem suas funções de forma eficiente. Realizar treinamentos e desenvolvimento contínuo da equipe de manutenção, promovendo a atualização técnica e a melhoria das habilidades operacionais. Monitorar o desempenho da equipe, realizar avaliações periódicas de desempenho e aplicar feedbacks para garantir a melhoria contínua do trabalho. 2. Planejamento e Execução de Manutenção Planejar e implementar o cronograma de manutenção preventiva e corretiva para todos os equipamentos da planta, minimizando paradas não programadas e otimizando a disponibilidade dos ativos. Garantir a execução eficaz das atividades de manutenção, como lubrificação, inspeção, ajustes e substituição de peças de equipamentos e instalações da fábrica. Realizar análise crítica de falhas e implementar ações corretivas para evitar a recorrência de problemas operacionais. 3. Gestão de Recursos e Estoque Gerenciar o estoque de peças de reposição e materiais necessários para a manutenção, realizando compras, controle e acompanhamento de inventário de peças e componentes. Trabalhar junto ao setor de compras para garantir a aquisição de peças e materiais de qualidade, dentro dos prazos e com o melhor custo-benefício. Controlar os custos de manutenção, garantindo o uso eficiente dos recursos financeiros disponíveis, otimizando os gastos com peças, serviços e mão de obra. 4. Melhoria Contínua e Eficiência Operacional Gerir e analisar indicadores de desempenho de manutenção, como o tempo médio entre falhas (MTBF) e o tempo médio para reparo (MTTR), e propor melhorias nos processos. Identificar e implementar melhorias nos processos de manutenção, utilizando ferramentas de gestão, como o PM (Planejamento de Manutenção) e o TPM (Manutenção Produtiva Total). Colaborar com outras áreas da produção para entender as necessidades específicas de cada linha e otimizar o uso dos equipamentos. 5. Gestão de Projetos e Inovações Tecnológicas Coordenar projetos de melhorias ou expansão de instalações, equipamentos e sistemas, implementando novas tecnologias ou modernizações nos processos de manutenção. Acompanhar a instalação de novos equipamentos e garantir que os processos de manutenção sejam adequados desde a fase de implantação. Implementar tecnologias de manutenção preditiva, como monitoramento remoto de equipamentos e análise de dados para identificar falhas antes que ocorram. 6. Segurança no Trabalho e Conformidade Regulatória Garantir que todos os procedimentos de manutenção sigam rigorosamente as normas de segurança do trabalho e as regulamentações ambientais aplicáveis. Promover a cultura de segurança, realizando treinamentos sobre o uso de Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPIs) e procedimentos de segurança. Realizar inspeções regulares nas instalações para garantir que todos os sistemas e equipamentos estejam operando dentro dos parâmetros de segurança e conformidade regulatória. 7. Análise de Desempenho e Relatórios Analisar relatórios de desempenho dos equipamentos e sistemas, fornecendo feedback para a equipe de manutenção e a gestão da fábrica. Preparar relatórios periódicos sobre o desempenho da manutenção, incluindo indicadores como custos, tempo de inatividade, e eficiência dos serviços prestados. Apresentar relatórios para a diretoria e outras áreas da empresa, propondo ações para resolver problemas de manutenção e melhorar a performance da planta. 8. Gestão de Contratos e Fornecedores Gerenciar contratos de serviços terceirizados relacionados à manutenção, como fornecedores de peças, consultorias ou serviços especializados. Negociar prazos, custos e condições com fornecedores, garantindo a qualidade e a entrega pontual dos serviços e materiais necessários para a manutenção da planta. Avaliar a performance dos fornecedores, garantindo que atendam aos padrões exigidos pela empresa. Profundo conhecimento em processos de manutenção preventiva, corretiva e preditiva, além de experiência com sistemas de gestão de manutenção (como CMMS). Conhecimento em gestão de equipes, controle de custos e planejamento de manutenção. Familiaridade com as normas de segurança industrial, regulamentações ambientais e boas práticas de manutenção. Noções de controle de estoque e gestão de fornecedores. Habilidades Liderança e gestão de equipes, com foco em desenvolvimento, motivação e resultados. Capacidade de análise crítica e tomada de decisões rápidas em situações de emergência. Habilidade em gestão de projetos, com foco na melhoria contínua dos processos. Excelente comunicação, tanto para reportar resultados para a direção quanto para interagir com as equipes de produção e outros departamentos. Habilidade para trabalhar com indicadores de desempenho e ferramentas de análise de dados. Características Pessoais Proatividade e visão estratégica, com foco em otimizar processos e reduzir custos. Forte senso de organização e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas atividades simultaneamente. Comprometimento com a segurança e qualidade em todas as etapas da manutenção. Espírito de liderança e habilidade para motivar a equipe a alcançar as metas estabelecidas. Competências Comportamentais Responsabilidade e forte foco em segurança; Organização e atenção aos detalhes; Boa comunicação e postura no atendimento ao cliente; Proatividade e agilidade na resolução de problemas. Procuramos profissionais que se identifiquem com o digital, que gostem de mídias sociais e saibam gerenciar, para que a venda também aconteça neste canal. Somos uma equipe focada em resultado e fidelização e pra isso nos dedicamos ao aprimoramento do relacionamento interpessoal e dos conhecimentos em moda e estilo. Além disso, temos como rotina da loja a organização dos produtos, transferências de mercadorias, fechamento de suas vendas e atendimento telefônico. SOBRE O GRUPO Somos um dos principais grupos de moda do país, com cerca de 60 lojas em todo Brasil e mais de 30 anos de história. O grupo é composto pela SACADA, OH BOY e pela linha teen da marca, a YOBOH. SACADA São 29 lojas e mais de 500 multimarcas levando à todo Brasil o mood sofisticado e elegante que marcam a trajetória da SACADA. A cada coleção o universo da moda, arte e comportamento dão vida à novos conceitos que traduzem o desejo da mulher contemporânea, aliados ao cuidado na escolha dos materiais para criar peças versáteis e únicas. Elegância e modernidade formam a essência da mulher SACADA, que busca sofisticação e praticidade para as ocasiões do dia a dia. Especialmente para ela, os itens clássicos e indispensáveis do armário feminino são reinventados, criando coleções que se adaptam perfeitamente ao seu estilo de vida. OH, BOY! Com 26 lojas próprias e presente em mais de 800 multimarcas, a OH, BOY! é uma marca carioca de coração, que possui essência descontraída, urbana e jovem. Esta leveza se traduz em coleções confortáveis, femininas e descontraídas que misturam influências e estilos refletindo nossa personalidade plural. Temos um olhar moderno e único, cuja essência é inspirada pela luz do dia e o calor do sol. Desde o surgimento da marca o jeans é destaque nas coleções com suas modelagens incríveis, qualidade de materiais e atenção aos detalhes. YOBOH A YOBOH é a linha teen na OH BOY e está presente em lojas selecionadas da marca, além do ambiente online. Criamos produtos com qualidade e conforto para meninas entre 10 e 16 anos. As coleções são idealizadas para atender a este público de consumidores da geração Z, que buscam expressar sua personalidade através de seus looks e valorizam um consumo de qualidade. Vai ser um prazer contar com você no nosso time. Vamos juntos? #J-18808-Ljbffr

We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. title: Senior HR Advisor GSS HR South America
description: About Us We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence. As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations. About The Role Purpose of the Role The Senior HR Advisor provides expert HR advisory support across South America, managing complex employee and labour relations cases. The role partners with managers and HR Business Partners from the Business Areas to ensure compliant, consistent, professional and people focused HR practices. The position sits within Global Shared Services HR, a global HR function delivering operational and advisory HR services across regions and acts as a local market specialist. Key Responsibilities Act as a trusted HR advisor to managers and employees, providing guidance on people related matters, HR policies, processes, and local labor legislation, supported by a solid understanding of the business and organizational context. Manage and advise on a broad range of employee relations cases, including performance and conduct issues, grievances, absence management, and disciplinary processes, engaging external legal support where required. Provide HR advisory support across the employee lifecycle, from onboarding to exit, ensuring consistent and compliant people practices. Manage relationships and negotiations with employee representative bodies, including trade unions, and liaise with labor authorities and external law firms on employment related matters. Support the business in the execution of organizational changes, including restructurings, reorganizations, workforce adjustments, and M&A activities, providing guidance on process, consultation requirements, and timing. Maintain, update, and contribute to local HR governance documents, templates, and policies, including the Personnel Administrative Guidelines, in line with regulatory and organizational changes. Ensure compliance with local employment legislation, collective agreements, and internal governance, applying HR policies consistently to mitigate risks and support fair and transparent people practices. Collaborate closely with GSS HR colleagues and Centers of Expertise to deliver high quality HR services and contribute to regional and global HR initiatives and continuous improvement activities. Use HR data, market insights, and benchmarks to support informed decision making, including areas such as compensation and benefits. Contribute to a collaborative and knowledge sharing HR environment that supports continuous learning and improvement. What we offer A meaningful role in a purpose driven, international organization Opportunities for professional and personal development within HR Supportive, inclusive, and collaborative culture aligned with company values Competitive total rewards package, including benefits and flexible working arrangements (country specific) DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity. About You Qualifications & Experience Relevant university degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Law, or a related field Typically 7+ years of operational/generalist HR experience, covering areas such as employee relations, recruitment, labour relations (including Union Management/Negotiation), change management, compliance, and compensation & benefits Solid understanding of local labor legislation and HR best practices in Chile, Brazil and/or Argentina Skills & Competencies Strong consultative and advisory skills, with the ability to influence and guide managers at all levels Customer centric mindset with a proactive and solution-oriented approach and strong stakeholders' management skills Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, comfortable handling complex or unfamiliar cases Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment Strong written and verbal communication skills in English is required as well as Portuguese and/or Spanish proficiency. Múltiplas empresas de diferentes segmentos competem pela atenção e pelo bolso do consumidor e dos anunciantes. Essa constante transformação vem muito da própria evolução da tecnologia no mundo. Nesse cenário, a Globo vem buscando diferentes segmentos de audiência, novos produtos, novas estratégias de distribuição, novas formas de operar e novos modelos de negócio. Para suportar tanta transformação, precisamos entender os movimentos da indústria, o mercado cliente, a nossa estratégia de negócio, as tendências de tecnologia, nossas alavancas e nossos gaps. Projetar novas capacidades de tecnologia, transformar algumas e, buscar inovação e parcerias, se faz absolutamente necessário. Atuação de Arquitetura A Arquitetura de Tecnologia da Globo, busca profissionais que possam trabalhar na interseção entre estratégia de negócio, tecnologia e a execução. A área tem a missão de desenhar e propor estratégias, arquiteturas e roadmaps de evolução tecnológica para diversos domínios de negócio e foundations de tecnologia da empresa. Faz isso com uma abordagem focada nos principais desafios transformacionais da empresa, nos níveis estratégico e tático e de maneira muito colaborativa com outras áreas de tecnologia e do negócio. A área se estrutura nos papéis de arquitetura corporativa, arquitetura de soluções e arquitetura de dados & IA. Traga sua experiência em benchmarks da indústria, mapas de capacidades, arquiteturas de referência, análises de gaps e buy or build e, construção de visões de futuro e roadmaps de tecnologia. O que a área te oferece Vai conduzir trabalhos de grande visibilidade que influenciam decisões estratégicas de tecnologia Você vai ter um conhecimento amplo da empresa e da indústria de mídia Vai desenvolver um olhar transversal e estratégico entre as capacidades de negócio e tecnológicas de toda a empresa Posição de Arquitetura de Dados & IA Esta posição irá ajudar a evoluir a arquitetura fundacional de dados & IA da Globo, que habilita os workloads de analytics, machine learning, generative AI e agentic AI. Portanto, diferentemente de uma área de delivery de software ou operação, as mudanças são sentidas no médio e longo prazo. description: OPEN TO APPLICANTS IN LATAM with experience in customs and export controls and legal background. In this role, you will provide legal guidance on customs and export control matters, support the development of compliant and cost-efficient supply chains, and help integrate trade governance into our global processes. Ensure that FME and affiliates operate globally in accordance with applicable trade governance laws and regulations, as well as applicable and relevant internal policies. Support and advise on the development and optimization of supply chains and flows of goods to achieve cost optimization in accordance with global trade laws. Support the integration and automation of trade governance processes into FME’s global operations and processes from a legal perspective. Support the development, implementation and continuous improvement of Global Standard Operating Procedures (GSOPs) for customs and export controls, providing legal guidance and review in collaboration with stakeholders. Continuous review of customs and export controls legislation and its applicability to FME business models and transactions. Legal support and guidance in customs broker engagement and performance reviews. Collaboration with stakeholders and the Customs and Export Controls Governance team for assessing training needs. Support global development and customization of trainings to FME professionals involved in trade-related activities. Support the coordination of global support for handling trade authorities’ audits, reviews and challenges. Support in the development for automation of trade-related processes and activities. Education Fully qualified lawyer, incl. above-average university degree. Experience and Required Skills 8+ years experience in customs and export controls in an international law firm and/or in-house legal department of an internationally operating and complex corporation, specializing in customs and export control matters. Preferred Master’s degree or equivalent. Experience in roll-out and implementation of customs and export control policies, processes and trainings. Ideally, experience in the healthcare sector. Technical Skills Good knowledge of global trade, including customs, and export control laws and regulations. Knowledge of relevant commercial, tax and supply chain processes. Ability to understand and apply regulatory requirements to business operations. Experience with relevant trade compliance tools or willingness to learn. Excellent written and spoken English, additional languages highly welcome. Soft Skills Innovation Mindset: embrace use of technology, automation and data analytics. Ability to work autonomously and to remotely. Ability to interpret complex customs and export control laws and regulations and apply them to real-world situations. Ability to deal with ambiguity, complexity and conflicting priorities, whilst keeping a focus on main drivers. Sound legal judgment under time pressure, balancing legal risk with business goals. Global mindset and cultural sensitivity, with the ability to work effectively across regions and time zones. Humor, highest professionalism for Fresenius Medical Care combined with self-modesty. Distinct and highly committed team-player. Team player with strong and effective communication and relationship skills. High ethical standards and professionalism. High attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy. Willingness to travel. Location Role allows for a remote hybrid working model in accordance with company policies. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental. Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades. Missão Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental. Visão Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros. O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS. O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Senior Manager, Ceremonies
description: Senior Manager, Ceremonies Department: Events & Entertainment Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC27”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. THE POSITION The Ceremonies Senior Manager leads the end‑to‑end planning, creative development, and operational delivery of all official ceremonies for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, including the Opening and Closing Ceremonies, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Pre‑Match Ceremonies (PMC), the Final Match Half‑Time Show (if applicable), and all additional ceremonial moments. Reporting to the Head of Entertainment, this role is responsible for overseeing the full lifecycle of each ceremony—from planning and preparation through to live execution—ensuring full alignment with FIFA’s vision and brand standards. The role also manages the implementation of the operational delivery across the entire FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, in accordance with the Ceremonies Concept developed by FIFA. Working closely with the Entertainment team and key Functional Areas, the Ceremonies Senior Manager acts as the senior operational lead for all ceremony delivery, ensuring creative and operational approvals are met and delivering iconic, culturally resonant moments that celebrate women’s football on its biggest global stage. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Ceremonies Project Leadership Lead the operational delivery and implementation of the Ceremonies Concept provided by FIFA. Manage the end-to-end planning and delivery of all official ceremonies across the FWWC27 tournament. Oversee ceremonies planning and delivery from concept development through preproduction, execution, dissolution, and legacy handover. Ensure full alignment with the Entertainment team in Zurich across all ceremonial workstreams. Manage the approval process for all ceremony related creative and operational deliverables. Provide senior decision-making support on creative direction, technical feasibility, and operational prioritisation. Lead the development of ceremony operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and show formats for all ceremonies, including PMC. Coordinate with Venue Management, Broadcast, Safety & Security, and other Functional Areas to integrate ceremonies seamlessly into matchday and event day operations. Act as the senior escalation authority for all ceremony related operational matters. Ensure all ceremonies reflect the approved creative vision, brand standards, cultural sensitivities, and tournament wide entertainment strategy. Team Leadership Manage and mentor the Ceremonies Team, providing clear direction, performance oversight, and accountability structures. Mentor and support all Ceremonies personnel, including fulltime staff, freelancers, and event time workforce, ensuring consistent standards, development pathways, and operational readiness. Support internal talent development through coaching, guidance, and structured feedback. Build team structures and optimize collaboration across creative, technical, and operational units. Foster strong coordination between venue based ceremonies teams to maintain consistency in delivery standards and operational execution. Foster strong teamwork, knowledge exchange, and operational alignment with the Stadium Entertainment Team to ensure unified delivery across all entertainment and ceremonial workstreams. Major Ceremonies Oversight Manage planning and delivery management for all major ceremonial events, including: Opening Ceremony, Closing Ceremony, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Final Match Half-Time Show (if applicable), Pre-Match Ceremonies throughout the tournament Ensure that each major ceremony reflects the ambition, brand standards, and cultural significance of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Creative & Concept Development / Creative Concept, Content Production & Management Collaborate with the Entertainment team to develop and refine the ceremonial concept and creative direction for each ceremony. Integrate host country cultural elements into ceremonial programming in a meaningful, authentic, and respectful way. Oversee creative brief development, content commissioning, and pre-production workflows with internal teams and external agencies. Ensure all creative content — including music, graphics, videos, scripts, translations, choreography and performances — is approved and locked in line with operational timelines. Manage stakeholder approval pathways to ensure content is delivered and archived in accordance with operational requirements. Manage IP and copyright compliance for all ceremony content. Planning Scheduling & Documentation Develop and maintain detailed project plans, WIP reports, and milestone trackers for all ceremony workstreams. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável. A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento. Experience developing Power Apps, Power BI dashboards or Power Automate flows (desirable). description: Position Summary The Senior Finance Analyst – Clinical Solutions Portfolio is a strategic, business‑partnering role responsible for portfolio‑level financial analysis across Clinical Solutions departments. The primary focus is project and portfolio financial health, including forecasting, budget performance, and financial controls, with an expanding remit into trial operations KPIs and measures as they relate to budget integrity, scope control, and delivery efficiency. This role requires a strong background in Project Finance within a CRO environment , excellent analytical and presentation skills, and the ability to engage credibly with department heads and senior operational leaders. Main Duties & Responsibilities Own and deliver portfolio‑level financial analysis for Clinical Solutions departments, including budget health, forecast accuracy, margin performance, and risk identification. Lead project financial oversight across the full project lifecycle, from award through closeout, ensuring adherence to financial best practices and internal controls. Perform variance analysis (actuals vs. forecast vs. budget) to identify drivers of change, scope creep, and emerging risks. Partner with project finance teams to ensure consistency and integrity of project‑level data feeding portfolio reporting. Support and enhance departmental forecasting and planning processes using clear, supportable assumptions. Monitor budget consumption, earned value indicators, and change order impacts across portfolios. Provide forward‑looking insights to support proactive financial decision‑making by operational leadership. Contribute to the continuous improvement of financial processes, controls, and reporting standards. Develop and maintain trial operations KPIs and measures that link operational performance to financial outcomes (e.g., enrollment pace vs. burn, milestone progress vs. revenue, site activity vs. cost). Leverage Excel and Power BI to create scalable dashboards and analyses that support portfolio governance and executive review. Translate complex financial and operational data into clear, actionable insights for non‑finance stakeholders. Act as a trusted finance partner to Clinical Solutions department heads, supporting planning, performance reviews, and strategic initiatives. Prepare and deliver high‑quality presentations and executive‑ready materials summarizing portfolio performance, risks, and recommendations. Support ad‑hoc analyses and special projects requested by Finance leadership, Clinical Operations leadership, or executive management. Collaborate closely with Project Management, Clinical Operations, Data Management, and Finance teams to ensure alignment between operational execution and financial reporting. Minimum Education & Experience Bachelor’s degree (or its international equivalent) + 5 years of related experience. Preferred Education & Experience (optional) Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field (or its international equivalent). Approximately 5-8 years of relevant experience in project finance, FP&A, or operational finance, with a strong preference for CRO or clinical research industry experience. Demonstrated experience managing or analysing clinical trial portfolios and complex project financials. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (financial modelling, scenario analysis, large data sets). Working knowledge of Power BI or similar BI/visualization tools. Strong presentation and communication skills, with experience presenting to senior leaders and department heads. Solid understanding of clinical trial financial drivers, project lifecycles, and contract/budget mechanics. Knowledge, Skills & Competencies Strong financial and analytical acumen with the ability to connect operational activity to financial outcomes. Executive presence and confidence interacting with senior operational leaders. Ability to synthesize complex data into clear narratives and recommendations. High attention to detail balanced with a portfolio‑level, strategic mindset. Self‑motivated, adaptable, and comfortable operating in a fast‑paced, matrixed environment. Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation‑inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom‑line impact. To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading‑edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive. Working across industries and disciplines, we combine our experience and expertise to tackle the biggest challenges faced by society today. We go beyond what was once thought possible, creating new and innovative solutions to the world’s most complex problems. Leveraging BCG’s global network and partnerships with leading organizations, BCG X provides a stable ecosystem for talent to build game‑changing businesses, products, and services from the ground up, all while growing their career. Together, we strive to create solutions that will positively impact the lives of millions. You will collaborate with premier consulting teams around the world, applying your software development expertise across a variety of ambitious and ground‑breaking international projects. You will be instrumental in advancing BCG’s Consulting and BCG X teams by providing critical software development insights and speeding up project execution. As a Software Engineer, your role involves close collaboration with consulting teams to address complex and diverse technological challenges. You will apply your expertise in software development methodologies to add value to BCG’s Consulting & BCG X teams and Practice Areas. Each project offers a unique opportunity to showcase your skills and make a significant impact within BCG and our esteemed clientele. What You’ll Bring We are seeking technologically adept engineers who bring strong experience and diverse skills to our dynamic team. This role is an outstanding opportunity for someone who is passionate about software development and embraces opportunities to learn and make an impact in a fast‑paced, innovative environment. If you’re driven by technology and ready for impactful challenges, our BCG X Delivery team could be a great match! Technical Skills – Knowledge and Experience With Coding Skills: Strong coding skills and proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, Kotlin, Node.js, Go, Ruby, Rust, C#, etc. Experience with multiple languages preferred. Web Development Expertise: Experience with Typescript or JavaScript frameworks such as React, Next.js, and Angular. Demonstrated projects or work experience are helpful. Practical knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, or similar technologies. Familiarity with CI/CD tools like CircleCI, Jenkins, etc. Tech curiosity with interest and exposure to technologies like AR/VR, IoT, AI, Blockchain. Knowledge of infrastructure as code practices using Terraform, Chef, Puppet, or Ansible. Job Requirements Bachelor’s / Master’s in Computer Science or a related field Fluency in Portuguese and English Proven background in end‑to‑end application development, preferably in a commercial or consulting environment. Active contributions to open‑source projects or technical communities are highly valued. Core Attributes Software Development: Demonstrated experience in developing, testing, and deploying robust software. Examples of past projects or contributions are advantageous. Full Lifecycle Experience: Active involvement in the complete software development lifecycle, showcasing skills from idea generation to deployment. Efficiency Optimization: Experience in optimizing software for performance and efficiency. Dynamic Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast‑paced, client‑facing environment. Experience in client interactions for product development is a plus. Collaborative Skills: A track record of working effectively in team settings, sharing ideas, and co‑developing solutions. Additional Information Please apply for the positions equivalent to your previous work experiences. The seniority will be evaluated according to your experience and career structure at BCG X during the process. Even if you don’t meet all these requirements, we encourage you to apply if this job description excites you. description: Professor(a) de História (History) - Fundamental 2 - Barra da Tijuca/RJ O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo. SOBRE A VAGA A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos. Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo. Será um diferencial se você tiver: Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais; Espírito colaborativo - desejo de trabalhar como parte de um time; Pós-graduação em andamento ou concluída. description: Técnico de Imobilização Ortopédica - Rede Hospital Casa - CLT Somos a Rede Hospital Casa, um dos maiores operadores médicos hospitalares independentes do estado do Rio de Janeiro. Retirar aparelhos de imobilização ortopédica, conforme prescrição médica; Utilizar de forma adequada equipamentos como serra elétrica vibratória; Realizar procedimentos específicos em imobilizações ortopédicas, como a abertura de janelas no aparelho gessado; Manter sala de imobilização organizada; Zelar pela limpeza da sala, bem como organização e preservação e guarda de materiais e equipamentos de uso na sua especialidade; Auxiliar o médico ortopedista em procedimentos ortopédicos não cirúrgicos, como na instalação de trações esqueléticas e manobras de redução manual; Realizar lançamento e registro em prontuário dos procedimentos realizados e materiais utilizados; Promover orientações pertinentes e de conservação da imobilização aos pacientes; Auxiliar a equipe multidisciplinar em imobilizações de pacientes vítimas de trauma ou que necessitem de restrição total de movimento; Notificar a equipe de enfermagem toda e qualquer ocorrência administrativa; Notificar a equipe de enfermagem toda ocorrência durante atendimento ao paciente; Participar de treinamentos institucional e setorial quando solicitado sua participação; Cumprir as normas e regulamentos da Instituição, bem como as rotinas operacionais da sua Unidade; Respeitar e conhecer os instrumentos normativos do setor como instruções de trabalho. Esperamos que você tenha: Ensino médio completo com curso técnico em imobilização ortopédica. Registro no conselho de Classe. Desejável experiência anterior de 06 meses. Noções básicas de Primeiros Socorros a pacientes vítimas de trauma, Higiene ocupacional, biossegurança e ergonomia, equipamentos e Materiais ortopédicos. Noções de Ortopedia e Traumatologia. title: Event Controller
description: Event Controller Department: Finance Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team. THE POSITION Under the responsibility of the FIFA27 Head of Finance and in collaboration with the FIFA Finance division in Zurich and the Senior Event Controller, the Event Controller will support in Brazil the budget and forecast process throughout the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ project lifecycle providing finance business partnering and support to the various budget owners and to FIFA27 senior management. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Implementation Phase Assist with the implementation of the FIFA budgeting and reporting tools and organize hands‑on training with the budget owners in Brazil. Prepare cash flow forecast requirements in connection with the Brazilian operational budget. Planning & Operational Phase Support in Brazil the financial planning and budget review processes working closely with the FIFA Senior Event Controller (based in Zurich) and with all budget owners (Zurich and Brazil based). Work closely with the FIFA27 Senior Event Controller, to implement FIFA Finance processes in Brazil and to support a smooth consolidation of the full tournament operational budgets. Assist the presentation of the quarterly forecast exercise as well as recommended corrective actions (when necessary) to the various stakeholders. Support the accrual process at year-end supporting the FIFA Zurich and FIFA27 accounting teams and the various budget owners. Assist the review of monthly cost allocations to various project codes and prepare re-allocation journals when required. Support the preparation monthly management reports providing insightful commentary for budget owners and senior management. Monitor and maintain monthly cash flow forecasts, reflecting the Brazilian operational budget, to ensure the liquidity needs of FIFA27 are met. Perform ad-hoc analysis and prepare additional financial reports as requested by the Head of Finance and senior management. YOUR PROFILE Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field. Minimum 5 years of experience in accounting and Financial Planning & Analysis. Experience with budgeting and reporting tools. Experience in preparing financial statements, preferably in a multi‑entity environment. Experience in an international environment. Experience in procurement of advantage. SAP experience preferred. Well‑developed organisational skills with an ability to prioritize your workload and meet strict deadlines. Excellent written and verbal communication skills to facilitate business partnering. Have a proactive hands‑on approach to problem solving – a ‘can do’ attitude. Strong attention to detail and a focus on quality and accuracy. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Excel, Power BI Word & PowerPoint presentation. Ability to work independently and with a team in a fast‑paced and high‑volume environment. Right to work in Brazil. Fluent in English (spoken and written). Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written). Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Principal Product Manager, HTS API Marketplace
description: About the Role We are seeking an exceptional Principal Product Manager to build the HTS API Marketplace — the commercial and developer-facing layer through which enterprise partners access Hopper's lodging and cars capabilities. This is a true 0-to-1 role. You will be the person who defines what it is: how capabilities are packaged and priced, how partners discover and integrate them, and how the marketplace evolves as a platform business. The underlying technical capabilities — connectivity orchestration, pricing and sort, content mapping, the extranet — are owned by dedicated capability teams. Your job is to work closely with those PMs to understand, package, and commercially expose those capabilities as coherent, enterprise-grade API products. We expect this PM to move fast and build scrappily. You should be comfortable using AI tools and vibe coding to prototype workflows, mock APIs, and test partner experiences before handing off to engineering. The best candidate will reach for a prototype before a PRD. You will partner with Engineering, Data Science, Commercial, Finance, and Supply — and coordinate tightly with other PMs across the organization — to bring the marketplace from concept to a revenue-generating platform. This is a fully remote role. What Would Your Day-to-day Look Like Define what the HTS API Marketplace is: how capabilities are structured, packaged, and priced across a portfolio spanning HTS Connect, Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing, Extranet, Taxes, and Custom Deals Engine. Coordinate with capability PMs — who own the underlying technical systems — to understand each capability's roadmap, constraints, and customization surface, and translate that into externally-consumable API products. Own the commercial model for the marketplace: platform vs. variable fee decisions, take rate structure per capability, enterprise packaging, and the custom deals framework for large partners with differentiated customer segments. Build the developer and partner experience from scratch: API specifications, partner onboarding flows, documentation standards, sandbox environments, and integration tooling that minimizes time-to-first-value. Use AI tools and rapid prototyping to test ideas quickly — mock API responses, prototype partner portals, simulate pricing and ranking configurations — before committing engineering resources. Establish the go-to-market motion for the marketplace: work with Commercial to identify the right partners for each capability, sequence launches, and define what a successful commercial rollout looks like. Own the marketplace revenue P&L: model and track GBV, take rate, and per-capability unit economics in partnership with Finance. Set the sequencing and prioritization across all capabilities — from in-progress work (HTS Connect, Taxes) through scoping-stage products (Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing) to capabilities not yet started (Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Extranet, Custom Deals Engine). Qualifications 7+ years of Product Management experience, with at least one 0-to-1 product you built from concept to commercial launch. Demonstrated experience building developer-facing or B2B marketplace products, including ownership of API product design, developer experience, and commercial packaging for enterprise customers. AI-native working style: you use LLMs and vibe coding as first-line tools for prototyping, not as novelties. You have built working demos, mockups, or proof-of-concepts using AI before handing work to engineering. Strong understanding of marketplace economics: take rates, supply-side incentives, demand-side optimization, and the design of platform vs. variable commercial models. Ability to coordinate effectively across multiple product teams — you can synthesize roadmaps, surface dependencies, and drive cross-team alignment without owning the underlying engineering. Experience working with external enterprise partners: translating commercial needs into product requirements and managing partner expectations through multi-phase rollouts. Strong fluency with SQL and large-scale transactional or operational datasets. Exceptional written and verbal communication, including the ability to write crisp API and product documentation. Bonus Experience in travel commerce (lodging, cars, flights) or adjacent industries such as fintech, ads, or marketplace infrastructure. Background in connectivity, distribution, or supplier technology (GDS, channel managers, OTA APIs). Prior experience in Engineering, Data Science, or a technical role. Familiarity with auction or deduplication mechanics, dynamic pricing systems, or recommendation and ranking models. Perks & Benefits Of Working With Us Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and upsides of pre-IPO equity packages. Hopper will offer and cover 100% of employee premiums for private Major & Minor Medical insurances. Hopper supplements Social Security coverage for liability benefits with Private insurance to cover you and your loved ones from Day 1. Hopper provides employees with a tax-advantageous and secured savings vehicle and matches up to a percentage of employee contributions. Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!. Unlimited PTO. Flexdesk coworking All Access Pass AND Work-from-home stipend. Carrot Cash travel stipend. Hopper offers a monthly subsidy to pay for teleworking utilities. An entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business. Open communication with management and company leadership. Small, dynamic teams = massive impact. More About Hopper At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips. The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials. While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands. Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more. Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth: Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year. Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions. Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel. Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business. Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. title: Graphic Designer (Webtonic)
description: About Web Tonic Web Tonic is a done-for-you digital marketing agency serving B2B and B2C businesses generating $2M-$300M in annual revenue (Or spending at least 15k per month in ads). We operate as a full-stack execution partner - not advisors - across paid media, SEO, web development, landing page production, and marketing automation. Our clients span North America, Europe, MENA, and APAC. What This Role Looks Like This is not a "make it pretty" role. You’re a performance-minded designer who understands that every pixel has a conversion job to do. About 60% of your time will be spent designing landing page mockups and wireframes in Figma for service-based and eCommerce clients - taking conversion briefs, brand guidelines, and campaign strategies and turning them into high-converting page designs ready for development handoff. The other 40% is dedicated to static ad creatives for Meta Ads and Google PMax campaigns. What makes this role different: you don't just design - you think. You understand direct response principles, conversion hierarchy, and why certain layouts outperform others. You study what's working in paid media and bring that intelligence into every design you deliver. Key Responsibilities Landing Page Design (Core) Design landing page wireframes and high-fidelity mockups in Figma for service-based and eCommerce clients, optimized for conversion Translate campaign briefs, offer structures, and audience insights into clear visual hierarchies - hero sections, benefit blocks, social proof, CTAs Build responsive page designs (desktop + mobile) following direct response best practices: above-the-fold clarity, scannable layouts, friction-reducing form design Create design systems and reusable component libraries in Figma to accelerate page production across client accounts Deliver organized, developer-ready Figma files with proper naming conventions, auto-layout, and clear spacing/typography specs Iterate on existing landing pages based on A/B test results and performance data - not just aesthetic preferences Ad Creative Design (Static) Design static ad creatives for Meta Ads (Facebook/Instagram) and Google Performance Max campaigns across multiple formats and placements Produce scroll-stopping visuals that balance brand consistency with direct response performance - bold headlines, clear value propositions, strong CTAs Create ad creative variations for A/B testing: different hooks, layouts, color treatments, and copy arrangements Work from creative briefs and campaign strategies to produce assets that align with funnel stage (TOFU, MOFU, BOFU) Maintain a library of ad templates and design assets for rapid iteration across client accounts Understand platform-specific requirements: safe zones, text density guidelines, aspect ratios, and format specs for each placement Design Strategy (Differentiator) Proactively pitch layout concepts, creative angles, and visual approaches based on what's converting in paid media Advise on landing page structure and content hierarchy based on direct response principles and conversion data Analyze competitor landing pages and ad creatives - bring data-backed design recommendations to the table Collaborate with the paid media team to ensure creative output is aligned with campaign objectives and audience targeting Understand the difference between brand-first and performance-first design, and tailor outputs accordingly Operations & Collaboration Work closely with the paid media specialists, strategists, and account managers to align design output with campaign performance goals Meet turnaround deadlines with consistent quality, volume, and communication Organize and maintain a design asset library in Figma for easy retrieval and reuse across client accounts Incorporate feedback quickly and cleanly - revisions are part of the workflow, not an afterthought Required Skills & Experience 2+ years of experience designing landing pages, wireframes, or conversion-focused web pages for agencies, SaaS, eCommerce, or service-based businesses Advanced Figma proficiency: auto-layout, components, variants, design systems, responsive design, and developer handoff Proven portfolio of static ad creatives for Meta Ads, Google PMax, or equivalent paid media platforms Strong understanding of direct response design principles: visual hierarchy, conversion flow, CTA placement, trust signals, and friction reduction Experience designing for both service-based (lead gen) and eCommerce (product/DTC) contexts Solid grasp of paid media fundamentals: knowing what creative performs for TOFU vs. BOFU, how to structure ad variations for testing, and how platform placement affects design choices Ability to translate written briefs into clear, compelling visual layouts without heavy creative direction Strong typographic sense and layout discipline - clean grids, intentional whitespace, readable hierarchy Experience with design tools beyond Figma: Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva Pro for rapid asset production Strong written English (required) - ability to incorporate, edit, or suggest headline and CTA copy within designs Portfolio of landing page designs and/or ad creatives with a clear focus on conversion performance Nice to Have Experience working with B2B SaaS, digital agencies, or professional services brands Familiarity with landing page builders (Unbounce, Instapage, Webflow, or Elementor) and their design constraints Experience with AI-assisted design tools (Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, or equivalent) for asset generation and ideation #J-18808-Ljbffr

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo. Mas uma coisa deve ser comum a todos: o respeito. Acreditamos que a diversidade de perspectivas e experiências garantem um ambiente diferenciado de trabalho! O Programa Somos Todos Heróis - Diversidade e Respeito vem para fortalecer e apoiar o nosso posicionamento a favor do Respeito e da Inclusão e para trazer conhecimento e conscientização a todos os nossos Heróis. Acreditamos que times diversos podem garantir resultados espetaculares além de impulsionar nossa cultura inovadora. Conheça esta oportunidade de trabalho na Segurpro/ Cash e se você possui os requisitos para a vaga, FAÇA JÁ A SUA INSCRIÇÃO. Vaga aberta a pessoas com ou sem deficiência. Responsabilidades Qualificar e Prospectar oportunidades de novos negócios, identificando oportunidades, avaliando particularidades, oferecendo alternativas e promovendo ações que estimulem a demanda pelos serviços de Eventos e Global Risk no estado do RJ e, se tiver fortes contatos em demais estados, também será permitido a prospecção em outros estados. Capacidade de lidar com pressão de metas e resultados. Vivência na área comercial com experiência comprovada em vendas em Eventos e Global Risk e que tenha trabalhado em empresas do segmento de Segurança Patrimonial, preferencialmente. Disponibilidade de viagens quando necessário. Inglês avançado. #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: Pricing & Payments Manager, Partner Strategy & Experience Amazon is the most customer-centric company on Earth. We need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people who are passionate about doing the right thing. We are looking for a Pricing & Payments Manager to lead the Pricing, Incentives, Payments & Disputes function within Amazon's Last Mile Brazil organization. This role owns the end-to-end strategy and execution of partner pricing models, incentive programs, payment accuracy, and dispute resolution across our Amazon Partner Logistics programs — EDSP (External Delivery Service Provider), AMPL (Amazon Partner Logistics), and AMXL (Amazon Extra Large). As a People Manager, you will lead and develop a team of specialists, set the strategic direction for pricing and payment mechanisms, build scalable processes, and drive cross‑functional alignment with Finance, Operations, and Procurement to ensure partner economics are competitive, accurate, and sustainable. This position is based out of an Amazon corporate office and may require periodic travel. If you are passionate about partner economics, operational excellence, and building high‑performing teams, you should join our team. Key job responsibilities Lead, coach, and develop a team of Pricing, Incentives, Payments & Disputes specialists, fostering a culture of ownership, analytical rigor, and continuous improvement Own the end‑to‑end pricing strategy for logistics partners across EDSP, AMPL, and AMXL programs, ensuring competitive and sustainable rate structures Design, implement, and optimize incentive programs that drive partner performance, network efficiency, and cost effectiveness Oversee the payment lifecycle — from invoice validation and payment accuracy to dispute identification, root‑cause analysis, and resolution Build and maintain scalable mechanisms for pricing governance, incentive tracking, payment reconciliation, and dispute management Develop structured reporting and dashboards to monitor pricing competitiveness, incentive ROI, payment accuracy, and dispute aging/resolution rates Partner cross‑functionally with Finance, Operations, Procurement, and Legal to align pricing models with business objectives and contractual frameworks Identify and drive automation opportunities to reduce manual intervention in payment and dispute processes Conduct periodic pricing benchmarking and market analysis to ensure Amazon's partner economics remain competitive Manage escalations related to partner payments and disputes, ensuring timely resolution and stakeholder alignment Define and track KPIs for the team, establishing clear goals, performance standards, and development plans for direct reports A day in the life Your day starts with metrics review and the team's priorities. Your focus centers on strategic decisions that shape partner economics across EDSP, AMPL, and AMXL. You lead cross‑functional negotiations with Finance, Operations, and Procurement to align pricing models with business objectives. You assess incentive program ROI, recommending adjustments to optimize cost efficiency and partner performance. You review payment accuracy dashboards, identifying systemic gaps and designing scalable mechanisms to address them. Between meetings, you coach your team on stakeholder influence and data‑driven storytelling. Every day balances strategic thinking, cross‑functional alignment, and talent development to drive sustainable partner economics at scale. About the team The Pricing & Payments team is part of Amazon Logistics' Partner Strategy & Experience organization, supporting the EDSP, AMXL, and AMPL programs across Brazil — a network of +30 logistics partners and +300 operational nodes. Our mission is to ensure Amazon's logistics partners operate under competitive, transparent, and accurate pricing and payment frameworks, while driving performance through well‑designed incentive programs and efficient dispute resolution. We build scalable pricing models, payment governance mechanisms, and incentive strategies that balance cost efficiency with partner sustainability. The team sits within a broader strategic structure that also covers Compliance & Communications, Network Health & Performance, and VAS & DA Experience — working cross‑functionally to support Amazon's Last Mile growth in Brazil. title: Especialista em Ciência de Dados (Base em SP, RJ ou BH)
description: Especialista em Ciência de Dados (Base em SP, RJ ou BH) Job type: Full-time employee Somos aliados do médico durante toda a sua jornada e buscamos por pessoas que se identifiquem com nosso propósito, valores e cultura para se juntarem ao nosso time. Vamos juntos transformar a saúde com quem tem a medicina como vocação! Esta é uma vaga aberta na frente de Soluções para a Prática Médica para trabalhar de forma remota. Ao assumir o cargo de Especialista em Ciência de Dados na Afya, seu objetivo principal será liderar o desenvolvimento e a arquitetura de soluções avançadas de Machine Learning e GenAI, impulsionando decisões estratégicas e a evolução dos produtos digitais da companhia. Você atuará na área de Ciência de Dados dentro da diretoria de Tecnologia. Todas as nossas oportunidades são abertas a pessoas com deficiência (PcD) e reabilitadas do INSS. Liderar tecnicamente e arquitetar soluções de ponta-a-ponta em Machine Learning para os produtos digitais da Afya. Definir e conduzir a estratégia de experimentação e análise estatística avançada para otimizar o engajamento, retenção e o impacto das alterações nos produtos. Atuar como referência (SME) em GenAI, com foco exclusivo no fluxo de avaliações (evaluation), construção de Small Language Models (SLMs) e Fine-Tuning , garantindo respostas seguras e alinhadas aos objetivos de negócio. Influenciar o roadmap de produto e de outras squads (AIOps, AI Engineer) através da identificação de oportunidades baseadas em dados e da prototipação de novas soluções de IA. Estabelecer e disseminar boas práticas de código (Python) garantindo a qualidade e a performance dos modelos em produção. Mentorar outros cientistas de dados (Jr, Pleno, Sênior) em desafios técnicos complexos. Comunicar e defender arquiteturas, decisões técnicas e resultados de modelos complexos para stakeholders técnicos e executivos. O QUE BUSCAMOS (mas não esperamos que uma única pessoa atenda a todos os requisitos): Pós-graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas correlatas. Experiência avançada e comprovada em Python e suas principais bibliotecas (ex: Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch). Conhecimento profundo em estatística, design de experimentos (Testes A/B) e inferência causal. Vasta experiência com técnicas tradicionais de Machine Learning (Classificação, Regressão, Clusterização, Séries Temporais) e conhecimento de Deep Learning. Experiência sólida no desenvolvimento, fine-tuning e produção de soluções com IA Generativa (foco em LLMs/SLMs). Domínio do ciclo de vida completo de Data Science (MLOps/LLMOps), incluindo arquitetura, evaluation, monitoramento e observabilidade de modelos. Experiência na definição e implementação de Feature Stores , incluindo melhores práticas de governança, versionamento e disponibilização de features. Experiência prática com MLFlow para orquestração e versionamento de modelos. Domínio de ferramentas de versionamento (Git) e familiaridade com práticas de CI/CD. Inglês avançado (necessário para leitura de artigos científicos e comunicação técnica). Experiência prática com a plataforma Databricks. Experiência com processamento distribuído (Spark). GENTE É O MELHOR DA GENTE, por isso, oferecemos benefícios e parcerias para o nosso time. Confira os principais abaixo: Para o dia a dia: Vale-alimentação / refeição; Flexibilidade de horários e alocações (para vagas Remotas); Vale-transporte (para vagas Hibridas ou Presenciais); UP na remuneração: Multibenefícios: Benefício flexível via Cartão Flash para usar como preferir. Gympass / Wellhub; Plano de Saúde e Odontológico; Licença parental estendida (até 6 meses para mães e 20 dias para pais); Rede D'Ór: suporte e informações importantes para a saúde da mamãe e do bebê com uma rede credenciada de enfermeiros; Parceria com o SESC da sua região (programação variada nas áreas de educação, saúde, cultura, lazer e assistência); Day Off de Aniversário (um dia de folga para tirar no dia ou durante o mês do seu aniversário). Desenvolvimento e Aprendizado: Plataforma com diversos cursos para aprimorar seu conhecimento (UCA); Programa de desenvolvimento para líderes; Mentoria para Mulheres da Afya (MMA); Desconto em cursos de graduação e pós-graduação nas unidades de ensino da Afya. Diferencial para Professor Médico: Step 4: Etapa Atração 4 Etapa Atração Nosso propósito é transformar a saúde em conjunto com quem tem a medicina como vocação. Se você se identifica com o jeito Afya de ser, vem com a gente transformar a saúde com educação e tecnologia. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Assist other technicians during busy times and provide relief during breaks and lunch periods. Respond to all customer trouble calls and inquiries - initiate, review, update, and clear trouble tickets. Coordinate customer booking problems and transponder service extensions with Telesat Engineering. Perform satellite and transponder restorations as directed by the restoration plans. Coordinate customer additions and disconnects as directed by scheduled Service Orders. Coordinate satellite transponder change requests as directed by Engineering. Isolate and resolve satellite transponder interferences. Perform certification tests for all new digital uplinkers. Ground Station/Facilities Operations Operate, configure and monitor ground station subsystems, including: Electric, Air Conditioning, Communications, IT; Maintain and operate ground station equipment: Antennas, RF, IF, Communications, test equipment; Record all significant customer activities or internal events in the station log; Maintain and update facility site documentation; Perform preventive and corrective maintenance; Prepare Performance Analysis reports, as requested by engineering/management; Develop, maintain and distribute daily reports, operational shift logs and trouble ticket database to appropriate individuals on a needed basis; Prepare and distribute (E-mail) daily reports; File completed logs; Perform shipping, ordering, handling, inventory, and testing of on‑line and spare parts; Monitor building, fire, and security systems.
